name: Calendar Plugin
description: Official on-device calendar integration with multilingual AI guidance and rich Flutter UI cards for scheduling, viewing, updating, and deleting calendar events.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.8.0: Fixed first-message event creation reliability (explicit tool:'calendar' contract, lang=<code> stripping, camelCase Host API normalization, writable calendarId resolution + automatic retry, increased timeoutMs for OS permission prompts), removed all hardcoded static response text in favor of multilingual ai.complete generation, and added declarative Flutter UI cards for both bare /calendar event listings and event creation/update/delete confirmations (showing title, date, time, and description).

tools.description: Manage the user's local device calendar in ANY language. CRITICAL: Always include "tool":"calendar" and output ONLY ONE valid JSON object with no surrounding text or markdown. Supported actions: (1) "create" — schedule a new event with concise "title", exact 24-hour ISO-8601 "start" and "startDate" (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, resolving relative days like today/tomorrow/next Monday or specific dates from current local date/time; never use 12h format), exact "end" and "endDate" equal to start + durationMinutes (default 60 minutes if unspecified), integer "durationMinutes", and optional "description" (location, meeting link, notes, or attendees if mentioned). (2) "events" — list upcoming calendar events, optionally bounded by "startDate" and "endDate". (3) "update" — modify an event requiring "eventId" and "calendarId" plus changed fields. (4) "delete" — delete an event requiring "eventId" and "calendarId". (5) "help" — explain usage when asked how the calendar plugin works. Never invent event details the user did not state.

intentContract.description: ALWAYS emit "tool":"calendar". Interpret calendar requests in any language: schedule events with exact 24-hour ISO-8601 start/end timestamps, durationMinutes, and optional description; list events; update or delete by eventId + calendarId; or show help.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Concise event title without date/time phrases (required for "create").

fields.name: start
fields.description: Start timestamp in 24-hour ISO-8601 format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Identical to "start" (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss), or optional start bound for "events".

fields.name: end
fields.description: End timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss equal to start + durationMinutes (default 60 min).

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: Identical to "end" (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss), or optional end bound for "events".

fields.name: durationMinutes
fields.description: Event duration in minutes as an integer (e.g. 15, 30, 45, 60, 120).

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional event notes, location, link, or details mentioned by the user.

fields.name: calendarId
fields.description: Calendar ID (required for "update" or "delete", optional otherwise).

examples.input: schedule a medical appointment tomorrow at 3:30pm for 30 minutes at North Clinic
